notes: TradingView mobile chart snapshot, no chat text, so 'statements' is empty. All axis tags were read from a 3x upscale. Ambiguities: (a) the 2.4193 black tag overlaps and hides a grey gridline label beneath it (probably 2.4000) — the hidden label is NOT recorded; (b) the 1.4000 gridline label is partly covered by the 1.3763 price tag; (c) the role assignments for the coloured tags (green 2.0872 = target, grey 1.3492 = entry, red 1.2714 = stop) are inferred from TradingView's standard long-position-tool tag colours and from the green box being far taller than the red box — the tool's own label text is not visible, so the entry/stop/target mapping is an inference, not printed text; (d) the blue ray has no readable price tag; (e) the measure tooltip's −0.1932 (−12.95%) does not reconcile arithmetically with the 1.3492/1.2714 pair (0.1932/0.1295 implies a top of ~1.4919), which is why it is recorded as a separate measure tool rather than part of the position tool. Chart title is truncated as 'Binance...' by the app. Timezone is UTC+4 (Dubai), consistent with his 'Dubai midnight' references.
